lines.zh: 我贴着平原低飞，靴子不沾草。
lines.en: I skim low over the plain, boots never touching grass.

lines.zh: 阿吉萨的风把我的气吹偏了。
lines.en: The Ajissa wind pushes my aura off course.

lines.zh: 护目镜在扫地面，找热源。
lines.en: My visor sweeps the ground for heat.

lines.zh: 我一个人巡逻，也一个人报告。
lines.en: I patrol alone and report alone.

lines.zh: 我沿着山脊线走，视线最好。
lines.en: I follow the ridgeline where the view is widest.

lines.zh: 手里的爆能炮垂着，随时能抬。
lines.en: My blaster hangs low, ready to rise.
The grass is soft; flying is faster.

lines.zh: 我绕开那片树林，里面太密。
lines.en: I skirt that wood. It is too dense inside.

lines.zh: 靴底的推进器在轻轻响。
lines.en: The thrusters in my soles hum softly.
I call out coordinates as I move.

lines.zh: 这条路昨天也有人走过。
lines.en: Someone walked this line yesterday too.
I slow down. Something ahead.

lines.zh: 我悬在半空，慢慢转着圈。
lines.en: I hover and turn a slow circle.
The visor lens has gone a bit cloudy.

lines.zh: 我把爆能炮换到另一只手。
lines.en: I shift the blaster to my other hand.
This plain is too empty.

lines.zh: 我一个人站着，也不觉得孤单。
lines.en: Standing alone does not bother me.
I count the hills: four.

lines.zh: 能量读数很低，是块石头。
lines.en: The reading is low. Just a rock.
I thin my aura to save strength.
It gets hot under this shoulder plate.
Wind across the comm gives static.

lines.zh: 我在等一个不会来的命令。
lines.en: I wait for an order that will not come.
I stamp my foot on nothing.
There is smoke at the far edge of the plain.

lines.zh: 我把护腕的扣子重新扣紧。
lines.en: I fasten my bracer clasp again.
Stand still and let me scan you.

lines.zh: 你的读数很低，不值得我动手。
lines.en: Your reading is low. Not worth my time.

lines.zh: 这里是弗利萨军的巡逻区。
lines.en: This is a Frieza Force patrol zone.
Which direction did you come from?
I advise you not to raise that hand.
Those clothes are not local.
You cross this plain alone?
I count to three and you answer.

lines.zh: 你身上带着铁，我能闻出来。
lines.en: You carry iron. I can smell it.

lines.zh: 再看我的护目镜，我就开枪。
lines.en: Look at my visor again and I fire.
I watch this ground.

lines.zh: 你的脚在往后退，我看见了。
lines.en: Your feet are backing away. I see them.
Where are the others? Do not say none.

lines.zh: 把手放在我看得见的地方。
lines.en: Keep your hands where I can see them.

lines.zh: 你笑起来的时候，我更不信你。
lines.en: When you smile, I trust you less.
My raised hand means be quiet.

lines.zh: 这条线上不许有人乱走。
lines.en: Nobody wanders this line.

lines.zh: 最后一个问题，你叫什么。
lines.en: Last question: what is your name?
My shoulder plate is dented in.
I steady my ki and hold altitude.
Blood runs down my bracer.
Two steps back and I lift off again.

lines.zh: 这一下说明你还有点本事。
lines.en: So you do have some skill.

lines.zh: 我的护目镜歪了，视野缺一块。
lines.en: My visor is crooked and half the view is gone.
It hurts. I am still on patrol.
One gasp and my ki returns.

lines.zh: 我把伤处压住，不让它出血。
lines.en: I press the wound to stop the bleeding.
This goes into the report.

lines.zh: 补给箱开了，我先拿一份。
lines.en: The supply crate is open. Mine first.
I smell something roasted.
There is no hot food on patrol.
I chew the ration fast.
This smell takes me back to the barracks.
One more piece. Nobody counts.
My stomach growled. Embarrassing.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，分我一半。
lines.en: Half of what you are holding. Now.

lines.zh: 侦察镜扫到热源，我先报告。
lines.en: The scouter finds a heat source; I report first.
I stuff the rest into my chest pocket.
Back off. Do not touch my blaster.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的护甲，手疼吗。
lines.en: You hit my armor. Does your hand hurt?
I hover where you cannot reach.
Make way. I am on patrol.
You are lucky that was only a bump.
I turn and my aura brushes you.

lines.zh: 别踩我的影子，弗利萨军的。
lines.en: Do not step on my shadow; I serve Frieza's army.
We keep one block of spacing.
You knocked my visor crooked.

lines.zh: 再撞一次，我就记录在案。
lines.en: Bump me again and it goes in the log.

lines.zh: 同队的人，不会走得太近。
lines.en: Squadmates never grow too close.

lines.zh: 军营的床位一排排，没有两张并着。
lines.en: The barracks bunks stand in rows. No two together.

lines.zh: 我把她的编号记在护腕内侧。
lines.en: Her number is scratched inside my bracer.

lines.zh: 我们只在换岗时点个头。
lines.en: We only nod at the changing of the watch.

lines.zh: 有人问起，我们说不认识。
lines.en: If asked, we say we do not know each other.

lines.zh: 她教我怎样把气收得更紧。
lines.en: She taught me to draw my ki tighter.
The next rotation may split us.
I have kept one sweet for a long while.
At night I take half her watch.
We have never spoken of afterward.
This iron ingot is mine.

lines.zh: 爆能炮的零件掉了一地。
lines.en: Blaster parts are scattered all over.
I pick up a spent energy casing.
That blade on the ground is still usable.
I flip a stone and something lies beneath.
I tuck the iron scrap into my pouch.

lines.zh: 这枚螺丝正好配我的炮。
lines.en: This screw fits my blaster exactly.
I pick up a glinting piece of plate.

lines.zh: 掉落的东西都归我处置。
lines.en: Dropped goods are mine to dispose of.
I wipe my hand before picking it up.
Heat source at two o'clock.
The visor lights. Target confirmed.
He has run into the open.

lines.zh: 我抬手，气弹已经在指间。
lines.en: I raise my hand; a blast is already at my fingers.

lines.zh: 这点读数，我一个人就够。
lines.en: This reading needs only me.
He has looked back at me.
The target is speeding up. Pursue.
I have sent the coordinates to the leader.
His ki is a mess.
Once locked, you do not escape.
I take his legs first.
The one behind the rocks. Come out.

lines.zh: 他拿着武器，那就好办了。
lines.en: He is armed. That simplifies things.

lines.zh: 我在往上飞，他看不见我。
lines.en: I rise and he loses sight of me.

lines.zh: 护目镜给了确定的数字。
lines.en: The visor gives me a certain number.
He stopped, right at range.

lines.zh: 我在他头顶绕，等他自己慌。
lines.en: I circle overhead and let him panic.

lines.zh: 他的眼睛找不到我的位置。
lines.en: His eyes cannot place me.
No cover out here. Good.
I hold low and close in slowly.

lines.zh: 他开始跑了，方向很明确。
lines.en: He is running and his direction is clear.
I have already predicted his turn.

lines.zh: 这一带没有水，他跑不远。
lines.en: No water here. He will not get far.
I adjust my aura for a rapid burst.
He looks up and I drop at once.
He keeps panting; I keep counting.
He searches for cover and finds none.
My muzzle never leaves him.
He is calling for help. None comes.

lines.zh: 爆能炮抬起，先算你的心跳。
lines.en: Blaster raised—I count your heartbeats first.
I hear his heartbeat quicken.

lines.zh: 他伸手去拿东西，我不等了。
lines.en: He reaches for something. I stop waiting.
He backs to the cliff and his feet slip.
I press all my ki into my palm.
One push and the blast flies off my palm.
I dive and kick the back of his neck.

lines.zh: 拳头打在他的胸口正中。
lines.en: My fist lands dead center on his chest.
He blocked the fist, not the elbow.

lines.zh: 小气弹在他脚边连环炸。
lines.en: Small blasts pop in a chain at his feet.

lines.zh: 我抓住他的披风往下扯。
lines.en: I grab his cloak and drag him down.
A knee, then a punch, right after.
The beam punches over his shoulder.
One kick sends him into the grass.
His blade rings off my bracer.

lines.zh: 护腕的刀刃扫向他的喉咙。
lines.en: The edge on my bracer sweeps at his throat.

lines.zh: 气弹炸开了他身后的石头。
lines.en: The blast shatters the rock behind him.
He backs off and I keep hitting.
I twist his wrist.
The last one goes into his chest.
He rolls half a turn across the ground.

lines.zh: 我落在这片平原上，草被压平。
lines.en: I land on the plain and flatten the grass.

lines.zh: 阿吉萨的风迎面吹过来。
lines.en: The Ajissa wind comes straight at me.

lines.zh: 护目镜启动，环境扫描完成。
lines.en: Visor online, environment scanned.

lines.zh: 我从上方降下，慢慢站稳。
lines.en: I descend from above and settle my footing.
The camp sent me to this line.
One soldier is enough for this patrol.
The holy land's edge is right over there.

lines.zh: 我把炮口朝下，先看地面。
lines.en: Muzzle down, I check the ground first.

lines.zh: 风沙打得护目镜全是灰。
lines.en: The wind has dusted my visor grey.

lines.zh: 这片区域没人，正好开工。
lines.en: Nobody here. Good, I can work.

lines.zh: 我报了一遍自己的编号。
lines.en: I recite my own number.

lines.zh: 靴子踩下，地面凹了一寸。
lines.en: My boot lands and the ground dips an inch.
I settle my ki and start the patrol.
Smoke in the distance. Noted.

lines.zh: 降落的时候扬了一点尘。
lines.en: My landing kicked up a little dust.
I am the eyes on this sector.
No support, and none needed.
I raise a hand to show I am friendly.

lines.zh: 火焰卷上我的腿，我拍开。
lines.en: Fire climbed my leg and I beat it out.

lines.zh: 气断了，我直接摔到地上。
lines.en: My ki cut out and I hit the ground.

lines.zh: 水堵住我的气，我挣不出来。
lines.en: Water smothered my ki and I cannot break free.

lines.zh: 爆炸从我侧面来，我歪了。
lines.en: The blast came from my side and knocked me askew.

lines.zh: 一支冷箭扎进我的肋下。
lines.en: A cold arrow drove under my ribs.
Strange light coils around my wrist.

lines.zh: 补给断了，我飞得越来越低。
lines.en: Supplies cut off; my flight drops lower.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的护目镜黑了。
lines.en: Lightning struck and my visor went dark.

lines.zh: 我坠进一片没有重力的黑。
lines.en: I drop into a weightless dark.
